fix: Where two 'acute's sit close together (calyx lobes acute, corolla segments acute), check that the bearer goes with the nearer subject.
reason: 'corolla ... its segments 5-6 mm long, lanceolate, acute': corolla segments are petals here, and acute (sensu botany) fits. The preceding 'calyx lobes ... acute' would be sepal, so this is right only if this 'acute' is the second one.

'Plants minute, loosely gregarious' means the plants grow in groups; aggregated (synonyms clumped, clustered) on the whole plant follows the reviewed rule. 'Loosely' is lost but nothing false is said.
